crossRefs.note: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out…
But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in…
Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land…
I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
Sihon king of the Amorites; for his loving kindness endures forever;

people.name: Jahaz
people.line: A town in Moab, site of Israelite victories

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
translations.bsb: So Sihon and his whole army came out for battle against us at Jahaz.
translations.kjv: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
translations.asv: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, unto battle at Jahaz.
